info.title: StreamingApp API
info.description: Backend for the StreamingApp mobile apps and admin dashboard. Every error response has the shape `{ statusCode, code, message }`; clients branch on `code`. See docs/architecture/api-contract.md.

refreshToken.description: Opaque token; rotated on every refresh.

field.description: Path of the invalid request field

message.example: regions.0 must be an ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code
An active subscription is required to watch this content.

errors.description: Present on 400 VALIDATION_FAILED: one entry per invalid field.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token returned by login, register or refresh.

children.description: Lessons of a course, ordered by position

hasAccess.description: The only field clients may use to show "premium unlocked" UI.

receipt.description: Google Play purchaseToken, Apple signedTransactionInfo JWS, or for provider "fake" the original transaction id.

razorpaySubscriptionId.description: Pass to Razorpay Checkout as subscription_id

installationId.description: Generated once by the app and kept in secure storage.

DrmSystem.description: DRM systems this client can play (browsers: what EME supports; Android: ["widevine"]).

supportedDrm.description: DRM systems this client can play (browsers: what EME supports; Android: ["widevine"]).

licenseRequestHeaders.description: Headers to send on every license request, exactly as given (they carry the short-lived license token; names depend on the DRM vendor). Treat the values as secrets.

manifestUrl.description: Short-lived; never a permanent public URL

expiresAt.description: Playback authorization expiry, extended by heartbeats

duplicate.description: True when this event id was already processed; nothing was re-applied.

expiresAt.description: New period end, when the event has one.

parentId.description: Parent course. Required for lessons; courses cannot have a parent.

position.description: 0-based order among siblings; omitted puts the item last
0-based order among siblings (siblings are not renumbered)

uploadUrl.description: Short-lived URL to upload the source file to

headers.description: Headers the upload request must send
